name: commity
description: Automatically generate Conventional Commit messages by analyzing completed tasks in TASKS.md using AI.

enumDescriptions: Automatically select the best available provider
Use VS Code built-in Language Model API
Use OpenRouter (access hundreds of models with one API key)
commity.preferredProvider.description: Preferred AI provider for generating commit messages.

commity.openaiApiKey.description: API key for OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible service.
commity.openaiApiKey.markdownDescription: API key for OpenAI or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Also supports Ollama, LM Studio, etc.

commity.openaiBaseUrl.description: Base URL for the OpenAI-compatible API endpoint.
commity.openaiBaseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for the API. Change this to use Ollama (`http://localhost:11434/v1`), LM Studio, or other compatible services.

commity.model.description: Model name to use when calling OpenAI-compatible API.

commity.temperature.description: Sampling temperature for the AI model (0 = deterministic, 2 = very creative).

commity.promptTemplate.description: Custom prompt template. Use {tasks} as placeholder for the task list. Leave empty to use the default template.
commity.promptTemplate.markdownDescription: Custom prompt template. Use `{tasks}` as a placeholder for the completed task list. Leave empty to use the built-in template.

commity.preferredTasksFilename.description: Preferred tasks file name to use (e.g. TASKS.md). Leave empty to auto-detect.
commity.preferredTasksFilename.markdownDescription: Preferred tasks file name (e.g. `TASKS.md`). If empty, Commity searches for `TASKS.md`, `tasks.md`, `Todo.md`, `TODO.md`.

commity.autoCopy.description: Automatically copy the generated commit message to clipboard.

commity.maxRetries.description: Maximum number of retries when AI response is invalid.

commity.openrouterApiKey.description: API key for OpenRouter (openrouter.ai). Get a free key at https://openrouter.ai/keys
commity.openrouterApiKey.markdownDescription: API key for [OpenRouter](https://openrouter.ai). Gives access to GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini and hundreds of other models. Get a free key at https://openrouter.ai/keys.

commity.openrouterModel.description: Model ID to use with OpenRouter. Default is 'openrouter/auto' which lets OpenRouter pick the best available model.
commity.openrouterModel.markdownDescription: Model to use via OpenRouter. Default `openrouter/auto` picks the best available option automatically. You can also specify any model ID from [openrouter.ai/models](https://openrouter.ai/models) e.g. `anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet`, `openai/gpt-4o`, `google/gemini-pro`.

commity.enableAutoUpdater.description: Automatically check for Commity updates from GitHub releases on startup. Disable this if you installed Commity from the VS Code Marketplace (updates are handled automatically there).

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
